thread:
lina: quick thought — pilot a PM Remediation Accelerator: short deadlines, required backups, and lightweight IC shift notes. goal: fewer actions >30d.

gabe: sounds good. what's the concrete flow you want to trial?

lina: draft flow below (compact so bots can enforce):
```
T0 (publish PM): create GH issues for each action with fields: owner, backup, due=14d, risk(low|med|high), quick_mitigation(1-2 lines), impact_one_liner
T+3d: 15m triage -> confirm owners/backups and mark any >14d as roadmap-deferral with PM sign-off
T+7d: bot heartbeat -> post short status table to #incidents; owners must update issues by EOD
T+14d: closure target -> closed OR moved to roadmap OR escalated with mitigation assigned
T+30d: recurrence scan -> auto-query last 90d; if similar incidents >=2, schedule recurring-review
IC rotation: monthly; when IC changes, prev IC must add 5-line handoff in PM doc and new IC must ack in a GH comment.
```

harry: add a tiny `recurrence_risk` field (none/possible/likely) and require a 2-line interim mitigation if owner is blocked.

sofia: for comms: bot posts T+7 heartbeat to #incidents, T+14 closure summary to #exec-digest (one-line + link), and if recurrence flagged, ping SRE leads. keep noise low.

ops-bot: scheduled: create_pm_actions_job (next_run 1745501500)

gabe: implementation note: GH issue template + small GitHub Action to parse PM doc, create issues, auto-assign based on oncall rota, and schedule Slack heartbeats. I can prototype.

lina: metrics for pilot: % closed <=14d, avg time-to-close, #escalations, #recurrence_flags. pilot target: run on 3 PMs next sprint. volunteers to review the PR?

harry: i'll review the PR.

sofia: i'll build the dashboard panels (open actions by age, % closed within 14d, recurrence flags by service).

lina: thanks all — i'll draft the one-pager + GH template and open PR by Wednesday, will post the one-pager to #incidents when ready. :white_check_mark:
